papers.title: Tribological Behavior of Ti-6Al-4V Alloys Processed by Selective Laser Melting and Conventional Casting Process
papers.abstract: This work presents a detailed assessment of the microstructural features and tribological behaviour of Ti6Al4V alloy produced by conventional casting followed by rolling (CR) and selective laser melting (SLM). The two fabrication routes yield markedly different microstructures: the CR alloy develops a dualphase α + β microstructure, whereas the SLM alloy forms a fine martensitic α′ lath morphology with enhanced hardness. Tribological experiments performed under various loads and sliding speeds reveal clear distinctions in frictional response and wear characteristics. The CR samples exhibit deeper ploughing grooves, stronger oxidation effects, and higher coefficients of friction, indicating that abrasive and oxidationassisted wear dominate their surface degradation. In contrast, the SLM samples show shallower wear tracks, reduced friction, and improved resistance to material removal, with delamination and adhesive wear occurring only under more severe test conditions. The lower COF and diminished wear severity observed in the SLM alloy highlight the advantages of its refined microstructure in stabilizing interfacial contact and reducing frictional energy losses. Overall, the results confirm the superior tribological performance of SLMprocessed Ti6Al4V for applications demanding high wear resistance and structural reliability.
papers.first_author_affiliation: CSIR-Institute of Minerals and Materials Technology (CSIR-IMMT), Bhubaneswar 751013, India
papers.venue: Journal of Innovations in Materials and Manufacturing Engineering

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究SLM成形Ti-6Al-4V的摩擦磨损行为，与增材制造生物医学材料方向相关，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: It reports only sliding wear and microstructure of solid SLM Ti-6Al-4V, with no porous lattice design, no stiffness/stress-shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM与传统铸轧Ti-6Al-4V的摩擦磨损差异。
summary_zh.method: 对两种工艺试样做不同载荷与滑动速度下的摩擦磨损试验并表征组织。
summary_zh.result: SLM试样因细小的α′马氏体组织硬度更高，摩擦系数更低、磨痕更浅。
summary_zh.validation: 销盘式摩擦磨损实验与显微组织表征。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to clarify how the fabrication route alters the wear response of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Cast-rolled and SLM Ti-6Al-4V specimens were microstructurally characterized and subjected to tribological tests across varying loads and sliding speeds.
summary_en.result: The SLM alloy, with its fine martensitic α′ laths and higher hardness, exhibited lower friction coefficients and shallower wear tracks than the cast-rolled counterpart.
summary_en.validation: Experimental sliding wear testing combined with microstructural and hardness characterization.

papers.title: Mission-aware Model Predictive Control for tactical microgrids under monsoon uncertainty
papers.abstract: Tactical microgrids in remote and mission-critical environments must ensure reliable power, reduce fuel use, and maintain acoustic stealth under uncertain renewable generation. However, most existing control strategies are either rule-based or single-objective, which limits their ability to handle these conflicting goals in real time.This paper proposes a mission-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for a hybrid PV–battery–diesel microgrid. The approach directly embeds mission priorities into the dispatch problem using a rolling-horizon optimization. A key novelty is the Survival Override mechanism, which protects battery reserves under solar forecast uncertainty and helps prevent mission failure.The framework is validated through co-simulation using Python and DIgSILENT PowerFactory with realistic solar data. The results show a 61.9% reduction in fuel consumption compared to conventional control. At the same time, the system maintains voltage stability and supports up to 20 hours of continuous silent operation. The controller also handles forecast errors of up to 15% through 15-minute receding horizon updates, avoiding early battery depletion and inefficient generator use.Overall, the proposed approach improves microgrid resilience, reduces fuel logistics, and enhances operational performance without requiring additional system capacity.
papers.first_author_affiliation: Jashore University of Science and Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究战术微电网的模型预测控制，与用户的生物打印、髋关节植入物、FEA代理模型和增材制造方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses energy dispatch and microgrid control with no connection to FEA surrogates, implant biomechanics, bioprinting, or additive manufacturing.

summary_zh.motivation: 偏远战术微电网需在可再生能源不确定下兼顾可靠供电、省油与静音。
summary_zh.method: 提出任务感知MPC框架，将任务优先级嵌入滚动时域调度并加入生存覆盖机制。
summary_zh.result: 燃料消耗降低61.9%，可支持20小时静音运行并容忍15%预测误差。
summary_zh.validation: 基于Python与DIgSILENT PowerFactory的联合仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Tactical microgrids must reconcile reliable power, fuel economy, and acoustic stealth under uncertain renewable generation.
summary_en.method: A mission-aware MPC framework embeds mission priorities into a rolling-horizon dispatch problem with a survival override that protects battery reserves.
summary_en.result: The controller cut fuel use by 61.9%, sustained voltage stability, and enabled up to 20 hours of silent operation under 15% forecast error.
summary_en.validation: The framework was validated via Python and DIgSILENT PowerFactory co-simulation using realistic solar data.

papers.title: A Graph-based World Model for Object Goal Navigation
papers.venue: Journal of Institute of Control Robotics and Systems

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究机器人目标导航的图式世界模型，与工程仿真、FEA或植入物设计无直接联系，仅作为世界模型方法学背景。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses graph-based world modeling for robot object-goal navigation and contains no engineering simulation, FEA surrogate, physics-based design optimization, or biomechanics/implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升机器人在未知环境中目标导航的样本效率与泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 构建基于图结构的世界模型，用于表示环境拓扑并支撑导航决策。
summary_zh.result: 在导航任务上验证了图式世界模型对目标导航性能的改进。
summary_zh.validation: 基于仿真导航环境的实验评估。

summary_en.motivation: The work aims to improve sample efficiency and generalization for object-goal navigation in unseen environments.
summary_en.method: A graph-structured world model is constructed to encode environmental topology and support navigation decision-making.
summary_en.result: The graph-based world model is shown to improve object-goal navigation performance in simulated tasks.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated through experiments in simulated navigation environments.

papers.title: Explainable artificial intelligence for laser powder bed fusion alloys: breaking the formability–performance trade-off via collaborative control

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文用可解释AI协同控制LPBF合金的成形性与性能权衡，与增材制造生物医学材料方向方法可迁移但未涉及植入体或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure-stiffness matching, no osseointegration or fatigue testing of implants; it is a process-optimization ML study on generic LPBF alloys.

summary_zh.motivation: LPBF合金存在成形性与力学性能难以兼顾的固有矛盾。
summary_zh.method: 构建可解释AI模型并协同调控多个工艺参数以优化成形与性能。
summary_zh.result: 实现了成形性与性能的协同提升并给出可解释的工艺窗口。
summary_zh.validation: 通过LPBF试样制备与力学性能测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Laser powder bed fusion alloys typically face an inherent trade-off between printability and mechanical performance.
summary_en.method: An explainable AI framework is developed to jointly tune multiple process parameters for collaborative control of formability and properties.
summary_en.result: The approach reportedly breaks the formability-performance trade-off while yielding interpretable process windows.
summary_en.validation: Experimental LPBF fabrication combined with mechanical property characterization.
